title: Three Sundays and One Short Tee
subtitle: 体育运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育运动（人与社会·文学、艺术与体育·体育与运动）
meta: 主题语境：体育运动（人与社会·文学、艺术与体育·体育与运动）　|　核心词汇：golf　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 golf 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the keeper ① taught the golf that no member in the club would have described, and he said the teaching was the whole of the Sunday. The ② golf, meaning the game itself and not the course, ran three Sundays and stayed undescribed in the book; golf, he said, is the only thing in a club that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of golf in that club had the same short tee beside it, and the ④ golf at the far green, meaning the form they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Golf, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the keeper said the describing is the part that fills three Sundays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the golf was the whole of the matter, meaning the swing and not the game. The ⑥ golf, meaning the swing and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; golf, he said, is either something you teach or the only word that means both a game and a swing. He said the swing is the part they remember.

By 1982 the ⑦ golf had become a line in a card, and the card had become an argument about the short tee. The ⑧ golf of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in November, was one club and three Sundays of describing; golf, he said, is either the form at the far green or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ golf I remember is the golf described in the card, which closed in 1984 and is still described as the quietest in the club. ⑩ Golf, my mother said in 1986, is the only game that improves by being described; all golf, she said, is a swing that has agreed to look like a game. She said the swing was the honest half.

answers.why: teach the golf 意为“教高尔夫球”，1977 年那位管理员教了俱乐部里没有一位会员肯描述的高尔夫球。
golf 意为“高尔夫球运动”，指这项运动本身而不是球场，它经过了三个星期日而在簿子上没有被描述。
golf 意为“高尔夫球运动”，指俱乐部里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一枚矮矮的球座。
golf 意为“高尔夫球”，指最远那片果岭上留给孩子们练的那种打法，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
golf 意为“挥杆动作”，指一件事里人人都练却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这一记挥杆就是那件事的全部。
golf 意为“挥杆”，指人人都练却无人提起的那样东西而不是这项运动，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
golf 意为“高尔夫球运动”，指记分卡里写到、被记录过的那一项，到 1982 年这一项成了卡上的一行。
golf 意为“高尔夫球运动”，管理员十一月写道，整件事的高尔夫之事是一家俱乐部和三个星期日的描述。
golf 意为“高尔夫球运动”，我记得的是卡上描述过的那一项，1984 年结束了，至今仍被说成俱乐部里最安静的一项。
golf 为抽象总称，母亲 1986 年说，高尔夫是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的运动。
